top_signals.title: UN Warns Global Warming Will Top 1.5C Within Years
top_signals.summary: The rise in global temperature is on track to soon exceed 1.5 degrees Celsius, likely within the next few years, a new UN Environment Programme (UNEP) report showed on Wednesday. In the best-case scenario, peak temperature rise will reach 1.8 C, the Limiting Overshoot report found. “While the international community has made progress on climate change, global action to cut greenhouse gas emissions has not been fast enough to avoid global warming crossing 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels in the next few years” the UN said in the…
